## Components

### Aurora

Northern-lights bands behind a hero, in CSS alone: three role-coloured radial gradients drifting on transform. 0 B of JavaScript on a `site/` page; under reduced motion the global rule stills the drift and the bands' base position (frame 0) is what remains.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `roles` | `readonly ColorRole[]` | — | Exactly three colour roles, one per band. Default `['accent', 'info', 'success']`. |
| `intensity` | `number` | — | Band opacity, 0..1. Default 0.5. |
| `speed` | `number` | — | Drift speed multiplier, 0.25..4. Default 1. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — | What the aurora sits behind. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### CountUp

A number that counts to its value. The server renders the FINAL text, so without script, under reduced motion and for a crawler the figure is already right; the tween is an enhancement.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `CountTarget` | yes | The final value: a number, or a `Money` (counted in minor units, formatted by currency). |
| `from` | `number` | — |  |
| `ms` | `number` | — | Tween length in ms; 0 shows the value at once. |
| `format` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | — | `Intl.NumberFormat` options for a plain number. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### EffectCanvas

The escape hatch for an effect the catalogue does not have: an app's own Canvas2D `draw` or WebGL2 `shader`, mounted on the same budget, pause and lost-context rules as every built-in. `fallback` is REQUIRED by type — it is the server frame, the reduced-motion frame, the no-GPU frame.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fallback` | `JSX.Element` | yes | What shows before an island draws, under reduced motion, and with no usable context. |
| `roles` | `readonly ColorRole[]` | — | Roles resolved to channels for `draw`/`shader`, 1..8. Default `['accent']`. |
| `speed` | `number` | — | Time multiplier, 0.25..4. Default 1. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — |  |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |
| `draw` | `(colours: () => readonly Rgb[]) => CanvasDraw \| ((colours: () => readonly Rgb[]) => CanvasDraw)` | — |  |
| `shader` | `((colours: () => readonly Rgb[]) => Promise<ShaderProgram>) \| (colours: () => readonly Rgb[]) => Promise<ShaderProgram>` | — |  |

### GlassSurface

A translucent pane over whatever is behind it, with the palette's text contrast kept (the alpha has a measured floor) and an opaque fill under `prefers-reduced-transparency`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | `number` | — | Pane opacity 0-1; never below the contrast-measured floor. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — |  |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### GradientOrbs

Soft role-coloured orbs drifting behind a surface, moved on transform and opacity only. The server frame floats in CSS; in an island the drift also holds offscreen and in a hidden tab.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `roles` | `readonly ColorRole[]` | — | One orb per role, 1..6. Default `['accent', 'info', 'chart-3']`. |
| `speed` | `number` | — | Drift speed multiplier, 0.25..4. Default 1. |
| `intensity` | `number` | — | Orb opacity, 0..1. Default 0.6. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — | What the orbs sit behind. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### GridGlow

The instrument-panel ground: ui's `grid-texture` with an accent glow drifting across it, in CSS alone. Both are withdrawn under `prefers-contrast: more` and `forced-colors`, where texture behind text is noise.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | `ColorRole` | — | The glow's colour role. Default `'accent'`. |
| `speed` | `number` | — | Glow drift speed multiplier, 0.25..4. Default 1. |
| `scanlines` | `boolean` | — | Horizontal scanlines over the grid. Default false. |
| `glow` | `boolean` | — | The drifting glow. Default true; false leaves the still grid. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — | What the grid sits behind. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### Marquee

An endless strip. The duplicate track is `aria-hidden` and `inert` (a link inside must not be tabbable twice); pausing and RTL are CSS, so the strip needs no script.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `() => JSX.Element` | yes | Called once per track: a DOM node can only live in one place. |
| `seconds` | `number` | — | Seconds for one loop. |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | — |  |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### MosaicGrid

A holographic tile wall: tiles shifting between two colour roles. The server renders frame 0 as real tiles (no blank canvas, no script needed); an island redraws the same function on a Canvas2D that `frameLoop` pauses offscreen, in a hidden tab and under reduced motion.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cols` | `number` | — | Tiles across, 4..32. Default 16. |
| `rows` | `number` | — | Tiles down, 3..20. Default 9. |
| `roles` | `readonly ColorRole[]` | — | The two colour roles tiles shift between. Default `['accent', 'info']`. |
| `speed` | `number` | — | Shift speed multiplier, 0.25..4. Default 1. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — | What the mosaic sits behind. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### Noise

Film grain over a surface: an SVG turbulence filter tinted with a colour role. Static by nature (no animation, no frame loop, no script), so it costs a `site/` page nothing and has no motion for reduced motion to take away.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opacity` | `number` | — | Grain opacity, 0..1. Default 0.12. |
| `role` | `ColorRole` | — | The grain's colour role. Default `'fg'`. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — | What the grain lies over. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### ShaderBackground

A GPU background behind a hero: `mesh`, `grain` or `dots`, our own GLSL on our own WebGL2 mount. The server paints frame 0 in CSS (no script, no flash); an island fetches only its preset's chunk, draws on WebGL2 or else Canvas2D, and falls back to that frame under reduced motion.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | `ShaderPreset` | — | Which shader. Default `'mesh'`. |
| `roles` | `readonly ColorRole[]` | — | `[ground, a, b, c]`: four colour roles. Default `['bg-soft', 'accent', 'info', 'chart-3']`. |
| `speed` | `number` | — | Animation speed multiplier, 0.25..4. Default 1. |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — | What the background sits behind. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### TextReveal

Text that arrives piece by piece. One readable node carries the words; the animated split is its `aria-hidden` twin, so a screen reader hears the sentence once and unbroken.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | yes | Already-translated text. |
| `by` | `RevealBy` | — |  |
| `locale` | `string` | — | Locale override; defaults to the page's (`useUi().locale`). |
| `stepMs` | `number` | — | Milliseconds between pieces; shrunk for long texts. |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |

### Tilt

A wrapper that leans toward the pointer. Off — not merely softer — for a coarse pointer, inside a modal's focus trap, and whenever motion is not allowed; the angle never passes `TILT_MAX_DEG`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxAngle` | `number` | — | Degrees at the card's corner, capped at `TILT_MAX_DEG` (15). |
| `children` | `JSX.Element` | — |  |
| `class` | `string` | — |  |
